messages:
Alex: Heads up — preview dashboard for tenant T-789 is showing ~+120 token credits after the finalizer job ran this morning. invoices look fine but preview credit graph spikes. Anyone else seeing phantom credits?
Maya: saw that for two tenants in us-west. looks correlated with priority_tier=burst in the preview events. :eyes:
Cheng: I pulled the ingest logs for T-789 around the finalizer window, see snippet: 
```\n{\n  "tenant": "T-789",\n  "event_ts": "2026-03-20T09:02:11Z",\n  "priority_tier": "burst",\n  "dedupe_id": null,\n  "tokens": 60\n}\n```
Cheng: there are duplicate-ish events (same request id) that bypassed dedupe because dedupe_id was null — looks like route enrichment dropped the fingerprint for burst-tiered requests.
Sophia: that matches an earlier rollback we did for route-enrichment v2 where burst traffic went to the fast-path and missed the fingerprint middleware. might be an ordering bug.
Alex: is the preview pipeline using different enrichment order than finalizer? could explain why invoices are ok but preview shows extras.
Cheng: yes — preview uses the streaming proxy path which applies enrichment in the proxy, finalizer reads post-processed events from the aggregator. if proxy enrichment fails to set billing_bucket or dedupe_id, preview aggregates count differently.
IngestBot: deploy "proxy/enrichment:v2.3.1" completed at 2026-03-20T08:45:22Z to us-west. Canary: 10%.
Zack: so short-term mitigation: force streaming proxy to tag events with billing_bucket header at edge before any fast-path routing. then preview and finalizer will have the same key. but that's a proxy change and client-impacting.
Priya: alternative: change preview aggregator to fall back to request fingerprinting using (client_id + seq_hash) when dedupe_id missing. cheaper and no edge change.
Maya: fallback would cover cases where dedupe_id is null, but we need to be careful about false merges. we should only apply for priority_tier!=burst?
Sophia: the root is enrichment order. patch idea: move fingerprint middleware earlier in proxy chain for all priority tiers. small change, low risk, can canary to 5% then 25%.
Alex: action items:
- Sophia to open a quick PR to reorder middleware (sophia/patch-1532).
- Cheng to run a one-off replay of enriched vs proxy-original events and produce a reconciliation diff for T-789 and T-412.
- Maya to add a temporary dashboard alert for preview-vs-finalizer delta > 50 tokens/tenant.
- Zack/Priya to vet preview fallback logic as backup.
Cheng: preliminary SQL I ran to spot the mismatch: 
```
SELECT tenant, SUM(tokens) as preview_tokens FROM preview_events
WHERE ts BETWEEN '2026-03-20 07:30:00' AND '2026-03-20 09:30:00'
AND billing_bucket IS NULL
GROUP BY tenant;
```
Cheng: results show T-789=120, T-412=80 and both had priority_tier=burst in logs.
Priya: opened ticket ENG-5128 and assigned to eng-platform oncall @Sophia. ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-5128
Sophia: PR opened: https://git.redwood.dev/r/redwood/proxy/+/2345 reorder fingerprint middleware. adding canary flag `fingerprint-first=true` on deploy.
Zack: plan to canary 5% now, monitor preview delta dashboard, then bump to 25% if green. rollback flag ready.
Alex: nice. also let's add a small e2e that asserts preview and finalizer totals match within 1% for sample tenants after change.
Maya: I'll push the alert rule in Grafana and wire an ops escalation if delta > 100 tokens for >10m.
IngestBot: alert muted for ENG-5128 patch window 2026-03-20T10:00:00Z - 2026-03-20T11:00:00Z per Sophia.
Alex: thanks team — keep updates here. will validate after the next finalizer run. :thumbsup:
